findings.description: Uses a non-strict comparison (>=) instead of the required strict greater-than (>), causing state updates even when the version is unchanged.
findings.evidence: Spec requires updates only when `version > state['version']`. Example: with state={'version':3,'writes':0}, calling `advance(state, 3, 'x')` returns True and increments writes to 1, whereas it should return False and leave state unchanged.

review.summary: The candidate implementation incorrectly allows updates when the new version is equal to the current version, violating the strict version comparison contract.
